snippet.title: What if Smash Ultimate had Fall Damage?
snippet.description:
Ya'll like Minecraft?

This started out as a joke but then, with the help of Pine, Ayerbe, and AMudkip, this became a reality. Fall Damage in a platform fighter is a horrible thing and I am glad I made it. Add it to my "why would you do this" collection of random exploding and changing sizes!

Download: Soon

Twitter: Twitter.com/GhostsSoup
Outro Song: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_5NoTKfwDAo
